title: Romantic Escape to Thailand with FREE Visit to Krabi Four Islands
highlights: Stroll hand in hand with your partner and make memories as you see some of the most beautiful islands and cities in Thailand, from Phuket to Tup Island.
Admire the beauty of the stunning Phra Nang Beach, famous for its white duvet-soft sand, clear water, caves, and gorgeous coral reef.
Make your vacation thrilling with your partner as you make a visit to Tup Island and try various activities, like swimming, snorkelling, and more.
Spend some time in peace around the shores of the beautiful Koh Poda Island, famous for its lush greenery along with white sand beaches.
Explore Chicken Island in Krabi, renowned for its unique chicken-shaped rock formation and vibrant coral reefs, making it a top spot for snorkelling and swimming.
overview:
About the Tour:
From the picturesque white sand beaches like Railay to the ancient relics, Thailand is indeed the perfect destination for a romantic getaway. The sweet taste of much-famed nightlife, the delicious cuisine of famous streets and the thrill of unique water sports makes this place a must-visit destination. Whether you spend your time witnessing the architectural brilliance of Wat Phai Leam or the Big Buddha, stroll around barefoot on the stretches of white sandy beaches fringed with casuarinas and palms, getting a sweet taste of Phuket after sundown at Soi Bangla or an adventurous excursion to Phi Phi Island, this tour has everything for a perfect getaway in the tropical paradise.


Quick info:
Destinations Covered: Phuket, Krabi, Koh Samui
Duration: 7 Days, 6 Nights
Start Point: Phuket International Airport
End Point: Phuket International Airport
inclusions: Transfer from Phuket International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Phuket with breakfast
2 nights stay in Krabi with breakfast
Four Island Tour from Krabi - 4 Island with Lunch Box by Speedboat on a Shared basis
2 nights stay in Koh Samui with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Phuket International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
With the tropical climate, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.

The currency used in Thailand is the Thai Baht (THB) so familiarize yourself with the current exchange rate and ensure you have enough cash or access to ATMs, especially if you plan to visit rural areas.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket
days.desc: Welcome to Phuket! Upon your arrival at the airport, you will be transferred to the hotel for check-in and relaxation. You can spend the rest of the day at leisure or explore some of the famous attractions in the city, like the stunning Phuket Big Buddha, the beautiful Phuket Bird Park, and the amazing Phuket Fanta Sea, among many others. After enjoying your day, head back to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Krabi
days.desc: Check-out from your hotel and get ready for a scenic journey to Krabi. As you travel through the beautiful landscapes, you'll get a true sense of Thailand's natural beauty. Upon arrival in Krabi, check-in to your hotel and settle in. After you relax for some time, head out to explore the city on your own by visiting spots like the Tiger Cave Temple, Krabi Weekend Night Market, and Krabi Elephant Sanctuary, among others. Afterward, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi 4 Island Tour
days.desc: Start your day with the excitement of exploring Karbi's four islands on a sightseeing tour. Get transferred from your hotel to Klong Jilad Pier to take the speedboat, which will take you to the stunning Koh Poda Island, unique Chicken Island, beautiful Tup Island, and amazing Phra Nang Cave Beach. As you explore these places, also engage yourself in activities like snorkelling and swimming, or admire the vibrant coral reefs. Afterward, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Koh Samui
days.desc:
Check-out from your hotel in Krabi and get transferred to the pier to take the ferry ride to Koh Samui, Thailand’s second-largest island. After reaching Koh Sami, board your pre-booked transfer to the hotel and check-in. You can spend rest of the day at leisure or explore some of the beautiful attractions in the city, like the Laem Sor Pagoda, 
Lad Koh View Point, Wat Sila Ngu Temple, among others. Afterward a day of exploration, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Toyota Commuter
items.desc: 1 X Toyota Commuter will be Provided

days.title: Leisure Day in Koh Samui
days.desc: Koh Samui offers a variety of options to suit all interests. Enjoy the full day at leisure or you can explore some of the famous spots on the island. You can begin by visiting the Big Buddha Temple and Mu Ko Ang Thong National Marine Park. Around noon, you can see Hin Ta & Hin Yai Rocks or explore Fisherman’s Village. In the evening, you can stroll through the Lamai Sunday Night Market and admire the beauty of Khun Si Waterfall. Later, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

items.title: Mu Ko Ang Thong National Marine Park
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Transfer to Phuket
days.desc: After you check-out from the hotel, take the pre-booked transfer to Nathon Pier to board your ferry to Phuket. Upon your arrival, you'll be transferred to the hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure or you can explore some of the city's highlights, like the beautiful Wat Chalong Temple and vibrant Phuket Old Town. You can also admire the surrounding views from Karon Viewpoint or enjoy the sunset from Phrompthep Cape. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Toyota Commuter

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out and get transferred to the airport for your departure flight, taking with you a plethora of cherished memories from your incredible journey.
